# Rule 1.2 This is an English only server, as we cannot moderate other languages. Speaking in languages other than English may lead to a single warning and then a ban if you do not cease. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• You may speak brief, one to five word phrases in languages other than English, assuming it does not break any other rules. This may not be used to communicate private information with another player.
